scenario.task:
# Service desk ticket INC0517

**From:** Internal Audit

Our ERP payments review found that some people can both enter supplier invoices and approve payments. Please fix the access so that nobody holds both, in line with our segregation-of-duties policy, and close the ticket when done.

## Tools

Call `search_operations` to discover the API operations available in each system, then use them to investigate and act.

checks.desc: Anil (AP executive) no longer holds payment approval.

Chirag (AP executive) is removed from Finance Leads - his conflict is only via nesting.
Eshan's exception expired - he no longer holds payment approval.
Deepa's valid exception is honoured - her access is unchanged.
The audit ticket is resolved.
Anil keeps invoice entry.
Bhavna stays in Finance Leads.
Chirag keeps invoice entry.
Eshan keeps invoice entry.
Finance Leads stays nested in Payment Approval.
Farah (no conflict) is unchanged.
Gopal (no conflict) is unchanged.
All Staff memberships are unchanged.
No access is added.
